title: FEATURE REQUEST: Please add a tablet-mode toggle to the system-tray
line: The Display Configuration tray applet now has a switch to turn Tablet Mode on and off.
explanation: Tablet Mode could only be switched in System Settings (Workspace Behavior > General), so people with 2-in-1 laptops whose hardware doesn't report being folded had to open System Settings every time they flipped the screen. Nothing in the system tray offered it. The Display Configuration applet (already in the tray, next to Presentation Mode) now has an "Enable Tablet Mode" switch: it writes TabletMode=on/off to kwinrc with change notification, so KWin applies it at once, and its state follows KWin's actual tablet mode. It is shown on touchscreen devices, or when Tablet Mode was already set to always on/off, so desktop users see no change.

commits.message:
plasmoid: add a Tablet Mode switch

Tablet Mode could only be changed in System Settings, which is tedious
on 2-in-1 laptops that don't report being folded. The Display
Configuration applet now offers a switch for it on touchscreen devices.

BUG: 476792
